title: SEC-1 Event-IR
description: Normalized, typed sensor-event intermediate representation for the Agentic SecOps Immune System. A collector lowers a raw signal (Tree-sitter parse, eBPF probe, TLS handshake, LSP message, boot attestation, ...) into one Event-IR record. Event-IR is the observe-layer feedstock for ProofArtifact claims (tools/proof-artifact-spine): versioned, deterministically canonically encodable (same encoder as the spine), provenance-explicit, privacy-labelled. Strict (additionalProperties:false) so unknown fields fail closed here, not silently downstream.

schema_version.description: Contract version. MAJOR.MINOR; a MAJOR bump is a breaking change to this shape.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this event. Recommended content-address form sha256:<64hex> (derived from the canonical encoding of the event minus event_id), but any non-empty opaque id is accepted so collectors can carry a native id.

time.description: Observation time, RFC3339 / ISO-8601 UTC date-time (e.g. 2026-08-03T14:22:05.123Z). Wall-clock of the collector; monotonic/logical clocks belong in facts when needed.

kind.description: Normalized event kind. Open enum by design (the SecOps taxonomy grows); a MINOR bump adds members. Tree-sitter/LSP lowering emits EDITOR_LSP_MSG / SOURCE_EDIT.

subject.description: What the event is about: the governed scope plus the immune-system labels (which host surface, which governance-lane topic).

scope.description: The governed extent the event was observed within (e.g. 'host/workstation-01', 'workspace/cases/p1', 'repo/prophet-workspace').

surface.description: Host surface H1..H7 the event was observed on (the WNZL/immune-system surface partition).

topic.description: Governance-lane topic LDA_01..LDA_23 (the estate's 23-topic LDA taxonomy).

facts.description: Kind-specific observed facts (the payload). Open object at this contract version; per-kind fact schemas are a documented seam (see docs/SEC-1-event-ir.md 'Tree-sitter -> Event-IR lowering').

provenance.description: How this event came to exist. Explicit and required: no anonymous events enter the immune system.

collector.description: The sensor/agent that emitted the event (e.g. 'ebpf-file-probe', 'tree-sitter-lower', 'tls-observer').

inputs.description: Content-addressed refs to the raw inputs the event was derived from (sha256:<hex> or opaque refs). May be empty for events with no upstream artifact, but the field is required (explicit empty, never absent).

tier.description: Privacy tier gating how far this event may travel: local_only (never leaves the host), proof_only (only its hash/claim may be published), share_aggregate (may contribute to aggregated statistics).
